annotations.title: Confirm Reply to Buyer (step 2: send it)

description: Step 2 of 2. Sends the message prepared by reply_to_buyer to the buyer it named. Call this ONLY after the seller has said yes to that message and recipient. Pass the message exactly as reply_to_buyer returned it; the server sends the text it froze and refuses different text (CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH). A message that goes out cannot be recalled, so send once: a token sends one message, and if you are unsure whether a send happened, call get_conversation to see whether it was recorded rather than preparing it again. A token expires after ten minutes.

conversation_id.description: The same conversation_id you passed to reply_to_buyer.

message.description: The exact message reply_to_buyer returned. Shown in your approval prompt; must match what was prepared.
